title: Classified DoD payloads as evidence of a secret space program

tellings.quote:
we know
that at Vandenberg Air Force bases there
are classified payloads that are
launched into space routinely.

plain: A researcher appearing on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels says it is known that secret payloads for the US Department of Defense are routinely launched into space from Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. He points to this, from around the 1980s and 1990s on, as a sign that there could be a hidden military space program the public does not see.
